title: Defeat Them! Rivals of the Artiodactyla

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: This is the end of the line. Surrender!

text_block_list.name: Snatcher
text_block_list.text:
Impossible?! You caught up to a motorcycle?!
This isn't some moped, it's a legit 250cc...

She stood resolutely in front of the thief.
The top-speed showdown against the motorcycle ended in Calstone Light O's victory.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Purse-snatching is a crime! If you take a bag, the owner loses it.
The person who loses it will be troubled. Apologize at once!

Bombarded by her blunt, unvarnished lecture, the thief could only
stare in stunned silence, unable to comprehend the fact that he had been run down.
choice_data_list: Thank you. That was incredible, Light O...
Thank you. That was amazing, Light O...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—No, it was nothing extraordinary.
I am truly glad you are safe.

I was just as utterly dumbfounded by her raw speed as the thief was.
That blazing sprint remained burned into the back of my eyelids.
—That night, in the gymnasium.

I boot up the virtual reality device, the "VR Umulator."
There was something I absolutely had to verify using this high-spec simulator.
choice_data_list: Just how fast was she going back then?
Just how fast was she going back then?

text_block_list.text:
It looked as though she had exceeded the maximum speed threshold achievable by an Umamusume.
I decided to run a simulation to see just what kind of speed she had reached.

First, I input a rough estimate of the speed I witnessed.
Then, I decided to pit her against various opponents.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAH!!

That's it. When she caught that purse-snatcher,
it looked exactly like this. The first rival to race against is—
VS Elephant!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, an elephant? I cannot match the length of your trunk, but in running, I shall prevail!
HAAAAAH!

Calstone Light O 
WIN!
choice_data_list: An elephant isn't enough, as expected...
An elephant isn't enough after all...

text_block_list.text:
Any ordinary Umamusume could beat an animal of this tier.
The next challenger is—
VS Deer!

This time, the opponent is a deer.
A deer's top speed could give some Umamusume a run for their money, but...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Go quietly munch on some deer crackers!
HAAAAAAAAAAH!

Calstone Light O 
WIN!
choice_data_list: Unbelievable! Even the deer...!
No way! Even the deer...!

text_block_list.text:
She effortlessly blew right past it. She truly is on an entirely different level from ordinary Umamusume.
In that case—
VS Pronghorn!

A pronghorn. Also known as the pronghorn antelope.
I took a gamble and threw in the formidable beast boasting the second-fastest speed in the animal kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
W-What?! Such speed...?! 
I have found you, my worthy rival! HAAAAAAAAAAH!!
A fierce neck-and-neck struggle continued for a while, but...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Kuuuugh...! Ngh!

Pronghorn 
WIN!

The pronghorn won. But it was close!
Calstone Light O's maximum speed is comparable to the 3rd fastest land animal on Earth!
And when looking at the estimated speed value—
choice_data_list: An estimated speed of... 75 km/h?!

text_block_list.text:
She had clocked a terrifying figure...
No Umamusume before or since has ever reached such velocity.
choice_data_list: I want to see it...! I have to see that running in an official race!

text_block_list.text:
My excitement was uncontainable. The surging passion within me as a Trainer
could no longer be held back.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? You're the Trainer from the other day.
Are you here to observe... the selection race?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I just had to see Light O run.
Yeah, I just really wanted to see Light O run.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I see... You'll likely see her full power today.
Considering who her opponent is, that is.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we contest in earnest?
Light O, are you prepared to stand upon this battlefield?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Run without pride, and I shall simply cut you down.
Prepare to become mere tarnish upon my Holy Sword.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Durandal...
To think they'd clash in such an important match.

—Durandal. A gifted sprint Umamusume who carries
herself like a medieval knight.

Her late burst is especially keen, like the holy blade of the hero Roland.
She's an opponent unmatched by nearly anyone, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —?! What incredible acceleration off the start...!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOOOH!

From explosive acceleration straight into top speed.
That run was... nothing short of a miracle.
choice_data_list: To think an Umamusume could run like that...

text_block_list.text:
It was a recurrence of that day. A reenactment of the flash of light
that blew right past even a motorcycle. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, the corner... and counterclockwise, my weak point...!
At this speed, I won't...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
An opening! Fourth Form—Dionysus's Thunderlance!
HYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! More. I can go faster!
FAAAASTEEEER!

Calstone Light O clings on with everything she has.
However, that was where her race ended.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My deepest thanks for such a fierce, spark-flying contest.
Yet there is nothing my Holy Sword cannot cleave.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, pathetic...
How could this...

Though she lost, it didn't mean victory was impossible.
On her own, this might be her limit, but...
choice_data_list: If only she had a Trainer...!

text_block_list.text:
There's still plenty of room to refine both her racing tactics and cornering.
If only I could offer her guidance...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how frustrating! So utterly frustrating!
To think it would end like this.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I should have reached a higher top speed!!
So... why didn't I...?!
choice_data_list: Light O! With the right approach, you can do even better!
Light O! With the right approach, you can do even better!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —? You are... the Trainer from the other day...

Calstone Light O may indeed be eccentric.
However, her passion for racing is undeniable.

If she truly wished to defeat Durandal,
I wanted to lend her my support by any means necessary.
choice_data_list: Next time, let's beat Durandal!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Beat Durandal...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: What on earth are you talking about?
choice_data_list: Wait, weren't you frustrated about losing?
Wait, weren't you frustrated about losing?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't care less about winning or losing.
What I regret is...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Failing to reach top speed!
I could have gone faster! Flown higher! Enough to float straight into the air!!
choice_data_list: THAT'S what you're mad about?! Not losing the race?!

text_block_list.text:
Her frustration wasn't over defeat, but a lack of speed...
Calstone Light O's obsession was completely different from any normal Umamusume.
